$Comment: The lantern bomb the Headless Horseman hurls at a player, in the saddle or on foot: a Rare Lantern Bomb's look on a lobbed arc that bursts where it lands (the shared Orbis_Boss_Bomb_Burst, which hurts players only). It bursts on striking a creature (ProjectileHit) or the ground (ProjectileMiss), and after 5 seconds in any case. The throw that launches it is tagged AimingReference, so the Horseman aims the arc at his target from LaunchForce and Gravity: more Gravity lobs it higher and shorter.
